title: Sign in · TrailRunCoach
lead: A training coach for trail running, Taiwan's 100 Peaks (Baiyue) and road running. Sign in with Google or email; the first time, you will be asked to read the terms.
note: We only read your Google account ID, name and email, nothing else from Google.
deleted: Your account and all its data have been deleted.
waitlist: We are full right now: sign in with Google and we will put your email on the waiting list, then let you know when there is a place.
error.expired: The sign-in timed out or the link is no longer valid. Please sign in again.
error.failed: The sign-in did not complete. Please sign in again.
error.unverified: This Google account's email is not verified yet. Verify it with Google, then sign in.
error.full: We are full right now. Your email is on the waiting list; we will let you know when there is a place.
error.rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.
error.setup: The site is still being set up; sign-up is not open yet. Please try again later.
signup.lead: {who}: before your first sign-in, please read and accept the documents below.
signup.error: That did not work. Please try again.
reconsent.lead: {who}: there is a new version of the terms. Please read and accept it to continue.
draft: These documents are still drafts; you will be asked to read and accept the final versions.
agree: I have read and accept the Terms of Service, the Privacy Policy (including the de-identified analysis across users), the Health Risk Notice and the Third-Party Services Disclaimer.
doc_open: Open the full text in a new tab
test.h: Sign in to a test account
test.lead: This is a one-time sign-in link from an admin: press the button to sign this browser in as the test account. The link then stops working.
test.go: Sign in as the test account
test.no_token: The link is incomplete. Paste the whole link the admin gave you into the address bar.
test.error.SIGNED_IN_AS_OTHER: This browser is signed in to another account. Open the link in a private window or another browser (the link has not been used).
test.error.MOCK_RUNNING: This test account's made-up data is still being built. Try again in a few minutes (the link has not been used).
test.error.LINK_INVALID: This link is not valid, was already used or has expired. Ask the admin for a new one.
test.error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.
test.error.failed: That did not work. Please try again.
error.google_account: This email already belongs to an account that signs in with Google. Press “Sign in with Google”.
email.register_link: No account yet? Sign up with email
email.error: That did not work. Please try again.
email.short: The password needs at least 10 characters.
email.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
email.no_token: The link is incomplete. Paste the whole link from the email into the address bar, or ask for a new one.
email.sent.register: If this email can sign up, we have sent a confirmation email: open its link within 24 hours. Not there? Look in your spam folder.
email.sent.reset: If this email has an account that signs in with a password, we have sent a link to reset it (valid for 1 hour). Not there? Look in your spam folder.
email.reset_done: Your password has been changed and every device signed out: sign in with the new password.
register.lead: We will send a confirmation email to your inbox: open its link, enter this password, read the terms, and your account is ready.
register.name: Display name (optional)
register.hint: At least 10 characters; not your email, a common password or one character over and over.
register.cairn: Accounts made with email cannot be linked with Cairn for now; to link Cairn, sign in with Google instead.
forgot.lead: Enter the email you signed up with and we will send a link to reset your password (valid for 1 hour).
reset.lead: Once the new password is set, every device signed in is signed out.
verify.lead: Enter the password you set when you signed up to confirm your email.
what: What is this? See the introduction →
cairn.next: After you sign in, the route from Cairn goes on into the Race manager. The first time, you accept TrailRunCoach's terms.
cairn.full: TrailRunCoach is full right now: you are on the waiting list and we will let you know when there is a place. Cairn's time estimate for this route still works as before.
